name: Message to the Wildhammer

chain: The Final Message to the Wildhammer

summary: At Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands, Otho Moji'ko says the Wildhammer are striking deals with the trolls' enemies, and this time the high elves are their partners. Otho wants a message sent to the Wildhammer dwarves in the blood of the Highvale high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge.

sections.title: A Message in Blood
sections.body: The Wildhammer are forging new alliances with the trolls' enemies, and this time the high elves are their partners. Otho Moji'ko spits at the thought. A message is owed to the dwarves, written in the blood of their new friends: slaughter every Highvale high elf you come across and leave the bodies as a warning. Highvale Outrunners, Scouts, Marksmen and Rangers gather at Quel'Danil Lodge, in the Hinterlands' northwest.

sections.title: Word at Revantusk Village
sections.body: When you return, Otho declares that the Revantusk are forging new alliances as well, and praises your work.

aliases: who gives message to the wildhammer
faq.answer: Otho Moji'ko, who stands in Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Where are the Highvale high elves located?
faq.answer: They gather at Quel'Danil Lodge, in the Hinterlands' northwest.

faq.q: Why does Otho Moji'ko want the high elves attacked?
faq.answer: Otho says the Wildhammer are striking deals with the trolls' enemies, and now they are working with the high elves. Otho wants a message sent to the Wildhammer dwarves, written in the blood of the high elves.

faq.q: Which Highvale elves does Otho want slaughtered?
faq.answer: Highvale Outrunners, Scouts, Marksmen and Rangers at Quel'Danil Lodge.
